sourceNotes.rawContent: Dazzle in this stunning silver-toned nath, featuring a unique arrangement of baguette and round white stones. This high-fashion statement piece is perfect for celebrations. To preserve its brilliant shine and delicate finish, ensure it stays dry and is stored safely away from perfumes and moisture after use.
